title: Grateful Dead Live at Buffalo Memorial Auditorium on 1973-03-31
lineage: Master Soundboard Reel > Cassette > DAT > CD-R

ai_review.summary: High‑energy March ’73 Buffalo show captured on a solid soundboard tape; the band roars through a monster “He’s Gone → Truckin’ → The Other One” stretch with crisp recording and stellar playing.
ai_review.review: This two‑track (SBD) source delivers a clean, slightly hissy but overall excellent sound that lets the band's fireworks shine.  Jerry’s tone is described as “on” and his solo on Tennessee Jed is called ferocious, while Phil’s bass drives the long jams from He’s Gone through Spanish Jam.  The set flows naturally, building momentum early and opening the floodgates after Truckin’, with standout moments in TLEO, Playin’ in the Band and a ripping Other One/Spanish Jam sequence.  A few listeners note occasional tuning pauses and a thin vocal mix on Donna, but the consensus is that this is one of ’73’s most enjoyable recordings.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews overwhelmingly positive (mostly 4‑5 stars) praising both the performance and the soundboard quality; only a handful of low ratings mention minor tuning or vocal mix issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and balanced with solid instrument separation; a slight hiss and occasional tape‑type noise noted, plus isolated tuning delays that interrupt flow for some listeners.

standout_songs: He's Gone > Truckin' > Drums > The Other One > Spanish Jam
show_quality.setlist_flow: Early set builds momentum, then the second half erupts after Truckin', delivering continuous jam flow with seamless segues; only occasional tuning pauses interrupt the otherwise smooth progression.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Tone described as “on”, incendiary licks throughout, top‑form solo on Tennessee Jed, and overall superb guitar work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass highlighted as driving the jams (“Sugar Magnolia keeps thumping Phil is ready to stop”), tearing it up during the long sequences.
band_member_comments.Bob: Right‑channel figure‑eight drum pattern noted; generally solid rhythm but no specific praise or criticism beyond that.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith briefly joins in a jam, otherwise keyboards are present but not singled out for special comment.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s drumming described as solid and part of the extended jam sections.
